title: China enters Korean War
note: CPV crossed Yalu River October 1950, confirmed by multiple sources.

title: Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship signed
note: Signed February 14, 1950. 30-year mutual assistance treaty confirmed.

title: Land Reform Law enacted nationwide
note: Agrarian Reform Law 1950; mass redistribution to peasants confirmed.

title: PRC annexes Tibet militarily
note: PLA invaded October 7, 1950; Battle of Chamdo confirmed.

title: Marriage Law abolishes feudal marriage system
note: 1950 Marriage Law outlawing arranged marriages and concubinage confirmed.

title: Mass political repression campaigns begin
note: Campaign to Suppress Counterrevolutionaries and Three/Five-Antis confirmed. Death toll range (500k–2M) is within scholarly debate.

title: Thought Reform Campaign targets intellectuals
note: 1951 ideological remolding campaign against intellectuals well-documented.

title: Korean War armistice signed
note: Armistice signed July 27, 1953 at Panmunjom confirmed.

title: First Five-Year Plan launched
Gao Gang purged from leadership
note: Gao Gang purged in 1953–1954; committed suicide August 1954 (not 1954 as implied by year=1953, but events began 1953). Year assignment acceptable as crisis unfolded from late 1953.

title: First Constitution of the PRC adopted
note: First NPC adopted constitution September 1954 confirmed.

title: First Taiwan Strait Crisis
note: PLA bombardments 1954; US-Taiwan mutual defense treaty December 1954 confirmed.

title: Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence proclaimed
note: Panchsheel principles proclaimed in 1954 by Zhou and Nehru confirmed.

title: Bandung Conference — China leads decolonizing world
Agricultural collectivization drive accelerates
note: Rapid higher-level cooperative formation in 1955 under Mao confirmed.

title: Hundred Flowers Campaign and Anti-Rightist crackdown
note: Campaign began 1956, reversal mid-1957. 300,000–550,000+ labeled rightists confirmed. Year assigned to campaign start (1956) is accurate.

title: Socialist transformation of industry completed
note: Private industry converted to state/joint ownership by 1956 confirmed.

title: Sino-Soviet ideological divergence begins
note: Khrushchev's secret speech 1956 triggering Sino-Soviet tension confirmed.

title: Great Leap Forward launched
note: GLF launched 1958; famine deaths estimated 15–55M (mainstream 30–46M) confirmed. Description's '15–55 million' range is within scholarly bounds.

title: Second Taiwan Strait Crisis — Quemoy bombardment
note: PLA bombardment of Kinmen from August 1958 confirmed.

title: Sino-Soviet nuclear cooperation breaks down
note: USSR suspended nuclear tech transfer; formalized 1959. Year 1958 acceptable as breakdown began then.

title: Tibetan Uprising and Dalai Lama's exile
note: Lhasa uprising March 1959; Dalai Lama fled to Dharamsala confirmed.

title: Lushan Conference — Peng Dehuai purged
note: Lushan 1959; Peng's letter and purge; Lin Biao replacement confirmed.

title: Sino-Soviet split becomes public
note: Bucharest/Moscow 1960 disputes; Soviet advisors withdrawn July 1960 confirmed.

title: China launches independent nuclear weapons program
note: Independent program under Second Ministry of Machine Building after Soviet withdrawal confirmed.

title: Great Leap Forward wound down — economic recovery begins
note: Liu/Deng wound down GLF 1961; Seven Thousand Cadres Conference January 1962 confirmed.

title: Sino-Indian War
note: October 1962 Chinese offensive; unilateral ceasefire confirmed.

title: Sino-Soviet split becomes irreversible
note: Nine Commentaries 1963; China refused Partial Test Ban Treaty confirmed.

title: China's first nuclear weapon test
note: Project 596 detonated October 16, 1964 at Lop Nor confirmed. Fifth nuclear power confirmed.

title: France recognizes the People's Republic of China
note: France-PRC diplomatic relations established January 27, 1964 confirmed.

title: Cultural Revolution ideological preparations begin
note: Critique of 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office' (November 1965) as opening shot confirmed.

title: China deploys troops to support Vietnam War
note: ~320,000 Chinese troops to North Vietnam 1965–1969 confirmed.

title: Cultural Revolution officially launched
note: May 16 Circular 1966; Red Guards; lasted until 1976 confirmed.

title: Cultural Revolution violence peaks — Revolutionary Committees
note: 1967 factional violence; Guangxi massacres; Revolutionary Committees confirmed.

title: China conducts first hydrogen bomb test
note: Project 639 thermonuclear test June 17, 1967 at Lop Nor confirmed. 32-month fission-to-fusion record confirmed.

title: Down to the Countryside Movement begins
note: 1968 rustication movement; ~16M urban youth relocated confirmed.

title: Sino-Soviet border conflict — Zhenbao Island clashes
note: Ussuri River clashes March 1969; Soviet nuclear threat; US rapprochement confirmed.

title: Lin Biao incident — designated successor dies fleeing China
note: Plane crashed Mongolia September 13, 1971 confirmed. Coup attempt and flight confirmed.

title: China admitted to the United Nations, Taiwan expelled
Bangladesh Liberation War — China backs Pakistan
note: China backed Pakistan in 1971; first UNSC veto on related resolutions confirmed.

title: Nixon visits China — Shanghai Communiqué
note: Nixon February 1972 visit and Shanghai Communiqué confirmed.

title: Japan normalizes relations with China
note: Japan-China normalization September 1972 under PM Tanaka confirmed.

title: Paracel Islands seized from South Vietnam
note: Battle of Paracel Islands January 19–20, 1974 confirmed.

title: Banqiao Dam disaster
note: Typhoon Nina; Banqiao failure August 1975 confirmed. Death toll range 85,000–240,000 is within the scholarly range (26,000 direct floods + up to 145,000 famine/disease = ~170,000–240,000 total). Description's '85,000–240,000' is consistent with published estimates.

title: Mao Zedong dies and Gang of Four arrested
note: Zhou died January 1976; Mao died September 9, 1976; Gang of Four arrested October 6, 1976 confirmed.

title: Tangshan earthquake kills hundreds of thousands
note: Magnitude 7.6 Tangshan earthquake July 28, 1976; official 242,000 deaths confirmed.

National college entrance examinations restored

note: Third Plenary Session of 11th CC December 1978 confirmed.

title: US-China full diplomatic normalization
note: US-China normalization announced December 1978, effective January 1, 1979 confirmed.

title: Compulsory Education Law enacted

note: Hu forced to resign January 1987; death April 1989 triggered Tiananmen confirmed.

title: Tibet protests — Lhasa crackdown
note: September–October 1987 Lhasa protests; martial law March 1989 confirmed.

title: Price reform triggers 'price storming' inflation crisis
note: 1988 price reform panic and inflation crisis confirmed.

title: Tiananmen Square massacre
note: June 3–4, 1989 PLA crackdown; death estimates hundreds to thousands confirmed.

title: Zhao Ziyang purged — Jiang Zemin appointed General Secretary
note: Zhao removed; house arrest until death; Jiang Zemin appointed confirmed.

title: Western sanctions imposed after Tiananmen
note: US and EC sanctions; EU arms embargo still in force confirmed.
